subject: Urgent: Temporary hold propagation and backup purge exception — CuraHealth
messages:
From: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@curahealth.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: CuraHealth Legal <legal@curahealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Requesting temporary hold propagation and backup purge delay

Hi Mateo,

We just received notice from our internal compliance team that they need an extra 10 business days of access to a set of production logs tied to a recent incident review. The request triggers our DPA clause on temporary holds — we need Redwood to delay the scheduled backup purge for the affected customer tokens and propagate a temporary hold flag across the retention orchestration so our audit team can finish evidence collection.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: 1) pause the next two purge cycles for the affected workspace, 2) extend the log retention by the 10 business days requested, and 3) provide a secure snapshot (read-only) of the relevant KV logs?

We also need an explicit statement listing any subprocessors that will have access to the snapshot and whether the snapshot will cross regions. Attachments: I included a short list of traces and the time window (backup-purge-matrix.csv).

Appreciate a reply today if possible — legal would like to sign an amendment if needed.

Thanks,
Sarah Mills
Sr. Security Operations Manager
CuraHealth

--- Attachment: backup-purge-matrix.csv (CSV, 14 KB)

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@curahealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-13T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Requesting temporary hold propagation and backup purge delay

Sarah — thanks for the heads up and the matrix. We're on this. Quick summary of what we can do and constraints: 

- Pause purge cycles: we can hold the next two scheduled purge jobs for the CuraHealth workspace. That will be implemented at the orchestration layer and should prevent deletion of the listed objects.
- Retention extension: we can add a 10 business day extension to the log TTL for the specific objects you flagged; we'll record the change as a temporary hold with an auto-expiry.
- Snapshot: we can produce a read-only snapshot (S3-compatible export) encrypted with your KMS key if you provide the key material or an alias. Snapshots will remain in the same region as the workspace unless you require cross-region transfer — that triggers subprocessors and data transfer controls.

Subprocessor access: the snapshot creation and storage will involve our storage subprocessor (HelixStore Inc.) and our S3-transfer provider (StreamMove). Both are listed in our subprocessor registry. If you need a narrower access list we can implement an isolation-only path but that will add ~24 hrs.

Next steps I propose:
1) Kimberly to confirm the subprocessor isolation path and ETA.
2) Laura to draft a one-off DPA addendum for the temporary hold (covering extension, snapshot handling, and subprocessors).
3) I will schedule the purge pause today after we confirm you want the full 10 business day hold.

I'll attach a short runbook (DPA-addendum-CuraHealth.docx) for legal to review.

— Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference

--- Attachment: DPA-addendum-CuraHealth.docx (DOCX, 28 KB)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai, Sarah Mills <sarah.mills@curahealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-13T13:21:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Requesting temporary hold propagation and backup purge delay

Copying in the pieces of work and timing:

- Subprocessor isolation path: we can perform the snapshot generation entirely within our dedicated eu-west-1 or us-west-2 storage pools; for CuraHealth (US region) we'll use us-west-2. That keeps the snapshot regional and avoids cross-border transfer.
- Access list: HelixStore Inc. will orchestrate the storage job but we can prevent StreamMove from touching the export if you prefer — we have an internal-only transfer path that keeps data in-house. If you choose internal-only, expect an additional 18-30 hours due to manual scheduling.
- Implementation ETA: if CuraHealth approves internal-only storage and provides KMS alias, snapshot ready in ~20 hours. If you accept standard subprocessor flow, we can do it in ~6 hours.

Technical note for Mateo: to implement the temporary hold we will flip the TTL override flag on the retention controller for the object set id listed in the matrix. I will record the override in the audit trail and attach the operation id.

Kimberly Park
Head of Trust & Safety, Redwood Inference
